title: add RAG agent tool-calling quickstarts and docs site updates
author: Sofia Patel
description: Adds a set of RAG-focused agent quickstarts and tool-calling examples to the docs site and redwood-examples. Motivation: provide opinionated, runnable examples that demonstrate how to wire RAG templates into agent flows, show tool-calling patterns (HTTP fetch, SQL, external search), and surface recommended config for embeddings, chunking, and LLM routing. This PR includes quickstarts for Python and TypeScript SDKs, a reusable RAG template library under examples/rag-templates, and docs site pages with copy, diagrams, and runnable code snippets. Checklist: - [x] Add rag templates and example agents - [x] Add Python and TS quickstarts with README and tests - [x] Docs site pages and navigation entries - [x] CI: unit tests + examples smoke tests pass - [x] Add release notes and changelog entry Related: ENG-5231, PM-142. Note: examples are small, pinned to stable SDK surface to avoid churn; follow-on PR will add more advanced tool examples and canary telemetry.
